DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昔の道具の展示をご覧ですね。名前が読みにくいものがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the old tools exhibit. Are there any names you find hard to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この道具の名前を読めません。形を見ると魚を捕るものかと思ったのですが、用途を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名前が読めず見た目から推測した用途を確認したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't read this tool's name. From its shape I thought it might be for catching fish, but I'd like to check its purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot read the name and want to verify the use you guessed from its appearance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見た目だけでは判断しにくいですね。まず読み方を作品票で確認し、用途の解説と照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's hard to judge from appearance alone. Let's first check the reading on the object label and compare it with the explanation of its use.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ふりがなのある説明はありますか。名前の読み方をノートに書いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ふりがなのある説明を求め読みを記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is there an explanation with pronunciation guides? I'd like to write the name's reading in my notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation with pronunciation guides and say you want to record the reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 補足の案内があるか探します。文字だけではわかりにくい場合、使う場面の図も参考になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll look for supplementary guidance. If words alone are unclear, a diagram showing it in use can help too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 道具だけを見るより、使っている図を見たいです。解説の中の図はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際の使用場面がわかる図を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than just the tool, I'd like to see a picture of it being used. Where is that diagram in the explanation?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to see a diagram showing the actual use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示資料の対応する番号をたどりましょう。こちらの解説と同じ番号の図を探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's follow the corresponding exhibit number. Can you find a diagram with the same number as this explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号が一致しているこの図ですね。帰ってから読み直せるよう、説明も写真に残していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資料番号一致の図を確認し説明を写真に残せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: This diagram has the matching number, right? May I photograph the explanation too so I can reread it at home?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Find the diagram with the matching item number and ask whether you may photograph the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮影の扱いは展示ごとに確認しましょう。撮影禁止の表示があれば、説明部分だけでも撮らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the photography rules for each exhibit. If a no-photography sign is displayed, don't photograph even just the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を確認します。撮れない場合は資料番号と道具名だけメモして、後で調べ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を確認し撮影不可なら番号と名前をメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the signs. If I can't take photos, I'll note only the item number and tool name and look them up again later.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the signs and note the number and name if photography is not allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料番号があれば質問もしやすくなりますね。それでは、解説と図を比べながら、残りの展示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The item number will make questions easier too. Please compare the explanations and diagrams as you enjoy the remaining exhibits.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 引き継ぎ前に表示を一緒に見てください。いつもと違うところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before handover, please look at the display with me. Is anything different from usual?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤い表示が出ています。普段は見ない表示なので、引き継いですぐ動かしてよいのか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 赤い異常表示が出ておりすぐ運転してよいか不安と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a red indicator. I don't normally see it, so I'm worried about operating the equipment immediately after taking over.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an unusual red indicator makes you unsure whether to operate immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動かさず、表示内容を確認して班長へ報告しましょう。あなたはまだこの装置の再起動の指導を受けていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's not run it; we'll check the message and report to the team leader. You haven't been trained to restart this equipment yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、検品だけ教わりました。再起動も、表示を消す操作も自分ではしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検品だけ習い再起動や解除はしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I've only been taught product inspection. I won't restart it or clear the display myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have learned only product inspection and will not restart or reset the display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでよいです。私も解除を判断する担当ではありません。異常の文言と、見つけた時刻を一緒に記録しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's fine. I'm not the person authorized to decide on clearing it either. Let's record the fault wording and the time we noticed it together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示にはセンサー異常とあります。今、交代時に見つけたことも書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: センサー異常と交代時に発見したことを記録すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The display says ‘sensor fault.’ Should I also write that I found it now, at shift change?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will record the sensor fault and discovery at shift change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、いつ気づいたかがわかるように残してください。装置の内部に手を入れて原因を探らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, leave a record showing when you noticed it. Don't put your hands inside the equipment to look for the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中には触れず、記録を班長に見せます。待つ間も、検品中の製品を別の箱へ移さないほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内部に触れず報告し待機中に製品を移してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't touch the inside, and I'll show the record to the team leader. While waiting, should I also avoid moving the products being inspected to another box?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report without touching the interior and ask whether products may be moved while waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 製品の扱いも班長の指示を待ちましょう。異常前後の物を勝手に混ぜないよう、今の状態を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's wait for the leader's instructions about the products too. Explain their current state so items from before and after the fault aren't mixed without authorization.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 装置も製品も今のままにして、異常表示と発見時刻を報告します。再開の指示を受けるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態を維持し表示と時刻を報告、再開指示まで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave both the equipment and products as they are and report the fault display and discovery time. I'll wait until instructed to resume.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will preserve the current state, report the display and time, and wait for restart instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 私はこの場に残って引き継ぎ状態を説明します。それでは、班長への報告をお願いします。戻ったら指示を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll stay here and explain the handover condition. Please report to the team leader, then. When you return, let's check the instructions together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知についてのご相談ですね。どの欄がわかりにくいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about the notice you brought. Which field is unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 税金の通知が届いたので来ました。支払う紙なのか、申告が必要という案内なのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 納付用か申告案内か区別できず相談に来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came because I received a tax notice. I don't know whether it's a payment form or guidance saying I need to file a return.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came for advice because you cannot distinguish a payment notice from filing guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表題と発行元をまず確認しましょう。封筒だけでなく、中の通知もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's first check the title and issuer. Have you brought the notice inside as well as the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。この表題には市民税とありますが、税務署で相談するものだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒と通知を持参し市民税だが税務署と思って来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. The title says municipal resident tax, but I thought I should ask the tax office.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought both the envelope and notice and thought municipal resident tax was a tax-office matter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 市民税の担当は市の窓口です。この通知に書かれている問い合わせ先をご一緒に探しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Municipal resident tax is handled by the city office. Let's find the inquiry contact written on this notice together.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この電話番号のところですね。担当へ何を伝えれば、通知の内容を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記載電話番号を確認し通知確認に必要な説明を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This phone-number section, right? What should I tell the department so they can check the notice's contents?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the listed phone number and ask what information is needed to check the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通知の名称と、どの部分がわからないかを伝えてください。こちらでは、この通知の支払状況や金額の変更を判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell them the notice's name and which parts you don't understand. We can't determine its payment status or changes to the amount here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 支払った記憶がありますが、別の時期の税かもしれません。通知と控えを見比べてから電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払ったが別期間かもしれず通知と控えを比較すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember paying, but it might have been tax for another period. I'll compare the notice and receipt before calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you may have paid for another period and will compare the notice and receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 税目や対象期間も見比べてください。同じ税だと決めつけず、手元の書類を担当へ説明するとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Compare the tax type and period too. Rather than assuming they're the same tax, explain the documents you have to the department.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名称と対象期間をメモします。市の担当に、支払いの控えを持って相談すべきか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名称と対象期間を記録し控え持参の要否を市へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the name and period covered. I'll ask the city's department whether I should bring the payment receipt for a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the name and period and ask the city whether you need to bring the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通知と控えを忘れずにお持ちください。それでは、市の担当へ内容を確認してからお手続きを進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Remember to take your notice and receipt. Please confirm the contents with the city department before proceeding.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はこの畝の草取りを手伝ってください。最初に、残す苗を一緒に見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please help weed this ridge today. First, let's look together at the seedlings to leave in place.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。ここに並んでいる葉と、畝の端の葉がよく似ていて、見ただけでは区別できません。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 抜く前に対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please. The leaves lined up here and those at the ridge's edge look very similar, and I can't distinguish them just by looking.
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm what to remove before pulling anything out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この間隔で植えてあるのが苗です。端にも残す株があるので、迷うものは抜かずに私を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: The ones planted at these intervals are seedlings. There are plants at the edge to keep too, so call me without pulling out anything you're unsure about.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いきなり畝全体を触らず、教えてもらった場所だけから始めたいです。作業はこのひもの内側までですか。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作業範囲を合意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Rather than touch the whole ridge right away, I'd like to start only in the area you showed me. Does the work extend only inside this string?
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Agree on the work area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その内側の、今示した小さい範囲をお願いします。苗の近くは道具で深く掘らず、根を傷めないようにします。手袋も着けてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do the small area I just indicated inside it. Near seedlings, don't dig deeply with tools or damage the roots. Wear gloves too.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手袋は持っています。この鎌は使い慣れていないので、今日は手で抜ける草だけにしてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: できる作業だけを引き受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have gloves. I'm not used to this sickle, so may I only pull weeds that can be removed by hand today?
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept only tasks you can do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それで構いません。鎌は使わず道具置き場に戻してください。抜きにくい草も無理に引っ張らず残しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's fine. Don't use the sickle; return it to the tool area. Leave weeds that are difficult to pull rather than forcing them.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残した場所を忘れそうです。この小さな札を横に置いて、あとでまとめて見てもらう方法はどうですか。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 判断できない対象を後で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I might forget where I left them. How about putting these little markers beside them and having you check them together later?
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Arrange to check uncertain items later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 札は苗に当たらない場所へ置いてください。抜いた草は通路に放置せず、このかごに集めてもらいます。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Put the markers where they won't touch seedlings. Collect pulled weeds in this basket rather than leaving them in the passage.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札で場所を示し、抜いた草はかごに入れます。ひもの内側が終わったら、自分で先へ進まず報告します。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合意した範囲で作業を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll mark the places and put the weeds in the basket. When I finish inside the string, I'll report rather than move ahead by myself.
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed within the agreed work area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その段取りでお願いします。私は隣の畝にいますから、判断に迷ったら止めて声をかけてください。では、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that plan. I'll be at the next ridge, so stop and call me if you're unsure. See you in a little while.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 来てくださって助かります。今日は折り畳み机の搬入をお願いしたいのですが、台車は扱ったことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you for coming; it helps. I'd like you to bring folding tables in today. Have you used a cart before?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 会社では使っています。ただ、子どもがこの道を通っているので、このまま机を積んで進んでよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 運搬を始めてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: I use one at work. But children are walking along this path, so I'm unsure whether to load the tables and start moving now.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check whether you may begin transporting the load. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ここは来場者の通路にもなるので、今は動かさずに待ってください。搬入用に分けた道を現場の担当と確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: This also serves as a visitor walkway, so please wait without moving for now. I'll check the separate delivery route with the person on site.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 先に荷物置き場で待ちます。受付まで運ぶのか、机を開いて並べるところまで担当するのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 引き受ける作業を明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: I'll wait at the luggage area first. Please tell me whether I'm taking them to reception or also opening and arranging them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Clarify the work you are agreeing to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: まず搬入区画の端まで二人で運んでください。机を開くのは別の担当です。区画内に通路をふさぐ物がないかも見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: First, two of you should take them to the edge of the delivery area. Another team opens the tables. Let's also check that nothing is blocking the passage within the area.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 角に段ボールが積まれています。私が移しても大丈夫ですか。それとも担当に確認した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 他人の荷物を勝手に動かさない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: There are cardboard boxes stacked in the corner. May I move them, or should we check with the person responsible?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Do not move other people's belongings without checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 持ち主がわからないので、勝手に動かさず私が確認します。机は荷崩れしないように一度に載せすぎないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: We don't know whose they are, so don't move them yourself; I'll ask. Don't load too many tables at once, so they don't shift and fall.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では積む前に相方と量を確かめます。歩行者が搬入区画に入ったら、止まって担当を呼ぶ形でよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 台車を止める条件を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'll check the quantity with my partner before loading. If a pedestrian enters the delivery area, we should stop and call the responsible person, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Share the conditions for stopping the cart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: その対応でお願いします。受付の担当が配置についてから、私が開始の合図を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: Please do that. After the reception staff are in position, I'll signal you to start.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 合図を待って二人で動きます。搬入が終わったら台車を戻して、次の机を取りに来る前に報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 決めた範囲で搬入を行う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: We'll wait for the signal and move together. Once the delivery is finished, we'll return the cart and report before coming for the next table.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Carry out delivery within the agreed scope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 手順を確認できましたね。開始までは荷物置き場でお待ちください。私は受付の配置を見てきます。それでは、後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-02-001-SHARED.translation: We've confirmed the procedure. Please wait in the luggage area until we start. I'll check the reception positions. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お米をお探しですか。普段はどのくらい炊いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Are you looking for rice? How much do you usually cook?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 一人分を週に二回くらいです。五キロの袋は使い切るまで長くかかりそうなので、もう少し小さい袋を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 使い切りやすい量を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Enough for one person about twice a week. A five-kilogram bag looks as though it would take a long time to finish, so I'm looking for a smaller bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose a quantity you can finish easily. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらには小さい袋もあります。味の好みや、炊き方について気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: We have smaller bags here too. Any preferences about flavor or questions about cooking?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この袋の「無洗米」は、とがずに炊くお米ですか。普通のお米と同じカップで量ってよいのかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 炊き方を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Does ‘no-wash rice’ on this bag mean I can cook it without rinsing? I'd also like to know whether I can measure it with the same cup as ordinary rice.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Understand how to cook the rice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 無洗米は、とぐ手間を省いて炊けるように加工したお米です。水の量はお米の案内や炊飯器の表示も確認してください。お使いのカップはどのようなものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: No-wash rice is processed so you can cook it without the work of rinsing. Also check the rice instructions and cooker markings for the water amount. What kind of cup do you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 炊飯器に付いていたカップですが、無洗米用かはわかりません。家で確認してから炊いた方がよさそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 水加減を推測せず確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: The cup that came with my rice cooker, but I don't know whether it's for no-wash rice. It sounds best to check at home before cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check rather than guess the water ratio. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そうですね。違うカップの容量で量ると水加減も変わります。この袋の炊き方の説明を残しておくと確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Yes. Measuring with a cup of different capacity changes the water ratio too. Keep the cooking instructions on this bag so you can check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 説明は捨てずに取っておきます。流しの下に置こうと思っていましたが、湿気が気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 米の保存場所を検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll keep the instructions rather than throw them away. I was going to store it under the sink, but I'm concerned about moisture.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Consider where to store the rice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 流しの下のように湿気が多い場所は避けてください。清潔でふたの閉まる容器に移し、保存方法の表示に沿って保管するとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Please avoid damp places such as under the sink. Transfer it to a clean container with a closing lid and store it according to the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: うちの容器に入る小さい袋にします。開封した日を容器に書いて、置き場所も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 量と保存条件に合う米を買う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: I'll take a small bag that fits my container at home. I'll write the opening date on the container and reconsider where to keep it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Buy rice suited to your quantity and storage conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、この袋をご用意します。炊き方の表示も確かめて、おいしく召し上がってください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-03-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'll get this bag for you. Check the cooking instructions too, and enjoy your rice. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ご注文がお決まりになりましたら伺います。気になることはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll take your order when you've decided. Is anything concerning you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: エビのアレルギーがあります。このうどんにエビが入っていなくても、ほかの料理と同じ鍋でゆでるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 注文前に調理方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I have a shrimp allergy. Even if this udon has no shrimp in it, I'd like to check whether it's boiled in the same pot as other dishes.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check the cooking method before ordering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 具材だけでなく、調理器具についても確認しますね。ほかに避ける必要のある食材はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll check the cooking utensils as well as the ingredients. Are there any other foods you need to avoid?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日はエビについて確認したいです。天ぷらを載せないだけで対応できるのか、厨房にも聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 具材除去だけで足りるか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Today I'd like to check about shrimp. Could you also ask the kitchen whether simply leaving off the tempura would be enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check whether removing the ingredient alone is sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 厨房へ確認しました。天ぷらは外せますが、ゆでる鍋や一部の器具は共用しているそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I've checked with the kitchen. They can leave off the tempura, but the boiling pot and some utensils are shared.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 共用しているのですね。別の鍋と器具を使って、一人分だけ作ってもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 店で対応できる範囲を知る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: So they're shared. Could you make just one portion with a separate pot and utensils?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Find out what the restaurant can accommodate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 本日は専用の器具で分けて調理する対応ができません。エビが混ざらないとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Today we can't cook separately with dedicated utensils. We cannot promise that no shrimp will get into it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それなら食事の注文はやめておきます。同行者が食べ終わるまで、飲み物だけ頼んでもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 確認結果から注文を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: Then I won't order a meal. May I order only a drink while my companion finishes eating?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide what to order based on the check's result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 飲み物のみのご注文について店の扱いを確認しました。お連れ様とお待ちいただけます。飲み物の材料も必要でしたら確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I've checked our policy for drink-only orders. You may wait with your companion. If needed, we'll check drink ingredients too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 材料を確認したうえで、温かいお茶を一杯お願いします。料理は注文しないと同行者にも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 注文内容を店員と共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: After checking the ingredients, one hot tea, please. I'll tell my companion too that I won't be ordering food.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Make your order clear to the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お茶の材料を確認してからお持ちします。ご事情を教えてくださってありがとうございました。それでは、いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-04-001-SHARED.translation: I'll check the tea ingredients before bringing it. Thank you for explaining your circumstances. Please excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お会計ですね。こちらがお席の伝票ですので、内容をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: You're ready to pay, correct? Here is your table's bill; please check the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 料理は合っていますが、ウーロン茶が三杯になっています。二人で一杯ずつしか頼んでいないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 会計前に明細を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: The food is right, but there are three oolong teas. I think the two of us only ordered one each.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check the itemized bill before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 二杯だったのですね。追加の伝票が入っているので、どの時点の注文か確認します。途中でお代わりはされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: So it was two. There's an extra order slip, so I'll check when that was ordered. Did you have any refills?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お代わりはしていません。氷が多かったので一杯だけ交換を頼みましたが、そのことと関係がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 誤記の原因を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: No refills. There was too much ice, so we asked to replace just one cup. Could it be related to that?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the cause of the incorrect entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 交換の記録を厨房と確認しました。交換分を追加注文として付けてしまったようです。こちらで一杯分を訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: I've checked the replacement record with the kitchen. It seems the replacement was entered as an additional order. I'll correct one cup here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 訂正ありがとうございます。修正後の数量と合計を、支払う前にもう一度見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 訂正を確認してから支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you for correcting it. Please show me the revised quantity and total once more before I pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check the correction before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらが訂正した明細です。お茶は二杯になっています。金額をご確認いただけたら、お支払い方法を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Here are the corrected details. The tea quantity is two. Once you've checked the amount, I'll ask your payment method.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 二杯になっていますね。今日は私がまとめて現金で払い、友人とはあとで精算します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 会計の進め方を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: It's two now, yes. I'll pay for everything in cash today and settle with my friend afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide how to handle payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 承知しました。お預かりした金額からお釣りをお返しします。明細の入ったレシートもご一緒にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Understood. I'll give you change from the amount received and an itemized receipt as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お釣りを確認できました。このレシートを使って友人と分けるので、折らずに持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 会計を終えて精算の資料を持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: I've checked the change. I'll use this receipt to split the cost with my friend, so I'll take it home without folding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Finish paying and take home the record for settling the cost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。伝票の誤りでお手数をおかけしました。お忘れ物に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-05-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you for checking. Sorry for the trouble caused by the bill error. Please remember your belongings on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 閉館までの時間をご案内しましょうか。見たい展示はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Would you like information about the time until closing? Have you chosen the exhibits you want to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: あと二十分くらいしかいられません。この地域の暮らしの展示を見たいのですが、どこから回るとよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 時間に合う見学順を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I can only stay about twenty more minutes. I'd like to see exhibits on life in this area. Where should I start?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask for a viewing order that fits your available time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そのテーマでしたら、入口に近い常設展示から始めると探しやすいです。企画展示にも関連資料がありますが、時間を見ながらご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: For that theme, starting with the permanent exhibition near the entrance makes it easier to find things. The special exhibition also has related items, but watch your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 常設展示を先に見ます。家族にも紹介したいので、資料を写真に撮って送ってもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 撮影ルールを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll start with the permanent exhibition. I'd like to show my family too; may I photograph the items and send the pictures?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check the photography rules. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 撮影は展示ごとの表示で確認してください。特に企画展示には撮影できない資料があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Check each exhibit's photography signs. In particular, the special exhibition has items that cannot be photographed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 企画展示のこの資料には禁止の印がありますね。写真の代わりに、同じ資料が載った図録を探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 撮影せず資料を紹介する方法を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: This item in the special exhibition has a prohibition sign. Instead of a photo, can I look for a catalog showing the same item?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Find a way to introduce an item without photographing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 図録に収録されているかは売店で確認できます。展示では資料の名前をメモして、売店の係に尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: The shop can check whether it's in a catalog. Note the item's name in the exhibition and ask the shop staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 資料名を控えます。説明文で「寄贈」の意味がわからなかったのですが、買って集めた品とは違うのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 展示の意味を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: I'll note the item name. I didn't understand ‘donated’ in the explanation. Is it different from an item purchased for the collection?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Understand the exhibit's explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 持ち主などから贈られた資料、という意味です。どなたから寄贈されたかは、その資料の説明にある範囲で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: It means an item given by its owner or someone else. You can check who donated it insofar as the explanation for that item tells you.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: わかりました。常設展示の説明を読んで、閉館前に売店で資料名を伝えて図録を聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 閉館前に必要な行動をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Understood. I'll read the permanent exhibition explanations and ask at the shop about a catalog using the item name before closing.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Take the necessary steps before closing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お時間を見ながらお楽しみください。展示室の出口はこの案内図で確認できます。それでは、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-06-001-SHARED.translation: Please enjoy your visit while watching the time. You can check the exhibition-room exit on this map. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物ですね。改札までの経路でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: That's a large suitcase. Are you having trouble finding the route to the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、このケースは階段で持ち上げにくいです。段差を避けて改札へ行ける道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 改札への移動方法を知る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, it's hard to lift this case on stairs. Please show me a way to the gates that avoids steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Find out how to get to the ticket gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: まず、こちらの構内図で現在地と改札を確認しましょう。エレベーターのある経路を係に確認しますので少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: First let's locate where we are and the gates on this station map. Please wait a moment while I check an elevator route with staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 待ちます。次の列車に乗るつもりでしたが、遠回りになるなら急いで運ばず、一本後にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 無理に急がず移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I'll wait. I intended to take the next train, but if it's a detour, I'd prefer the following one rather than rush with the case.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Move without rushing or straining yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 確認した経路は正面の階段を使わず、反対側の通路へ回ります。列車の時刻もこの案内で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: The route we've checked avoids the front stairs and goes around through the passage on the opposite side. Please check the train times on this display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この矢印の通路からエレベーターへ進むのですね。降りたあと、改札へ向かう方向も示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 経路全体を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: So I take the passage with this arrow to the elevator. Could you also show me which way to the gates after getting off?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Understand the whole route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 降りた場所からは改札の表示を目印に進みます。図にも順番を書きますが、途中でわからなくなったら近くの係へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: After getting off, follow the ticket-gate signs. I'll write the order on the map too, but ask nearby staff if you become unsure along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 順番がわかりました。改札でケースが引っかかりそうなら、通る前に係の方に相談してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 通過前に支援を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: I understand the sequence. If the case looks as though it might get stuck at the gate, may I ask staff before going through?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Ask for help before passing through. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、改札の手前で声をかけてください。通路をふさがない位置に荷物を置いて、ご案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, speak to staff before the gate. Put your luggage somewhere that doesn't block the passage and wait for guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、図の順に回って、改札の手前で必要なら相談します。乗る列車は到着してから時刻を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 安全に移動する次の行動を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Then I'll follow the map's sequence and ask before the gate if necessary. I'll check the time of the train to take once I get there.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide the next steps for moving safely. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ケースが周りの方に当たらないよう、ゆっくりお進みください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-YOSHINOGAWA-07-001-SHARED.translation: Please proceed slowly so the case doesn't bump other people. Take care.
